row.sso_plan: Contact Sales (all commercetools plans are quote-only)
row.evidence: commercetools' Identity Enterprise SSO FAQ: "Is SCIM supported? No, not at this time."
row.notes: Quote-only: commercetools publishes no plan prices (order-based pricing via sales). Enterprise SSO through commercetools Identity is OIDC only (SAML not supported), set up with the customer's CSM; the docs do not say which package includes it, so sso_plan is recorded as Contact Sales. SSO does not provision or deprovision: removing a user in the IdP does not change Merchant Center access, which is granted by Team invitations in the Merchant Center UI. No user-management API for Merchant Center users is documented. Audit Log Basic is included; Audit Log Premium is a paid add-on.

scim.notes: commercetools' Identity Enterprise SSO FAQ says SCIM is not supported. Enterprise SSO is OIDC only (no SAML) and covers authentication only.

audit_log_api.plan: Audit Log Premium add-on (Audit Log Basic included in B2C/B2B/B2X Commerce)
audit_log_api.notes: Change History API covers changes to Project entities (with the user who made them), via an API client with view_audit_log:{projectKey}.

user_api.notes: The commercetools HTTP API manages commerce Project data (customers, B2B Associates, API clients); no documented endpoint manages Merchant Center or Identity users, Teams or permissions. Team membership is managed in the Merchant Center UI. The Change History (Audit Log) API logs Project resource changes, not sign-ins or user administration.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/commercetools/ returned 404; commercetools documents an Okta OIDC client registration for Identity SSO, not a catalogue app.

fallbacks.notes: Identity SSO (OIDC) creates only an Identity account; new users have no Merchant Center access until invited to a Team. Merchant Center Teams can export members to CSV, but no CSV import of users is documented. The legacy Merchant Center OIDC SSO (pre-October 2025) assigned new users to a default team on first login.
